description: Reviewed revised target for the selected level-5 Goblin Warrior, one-handed Shortsword and Heavy Breastplate reference: aim near 70% clear rate, with an inclusive 50-90% band for each fixed Blood Grove pairing. This policy supersedes the initial 65-75% band and applies only when explicitly selected for evaluation; other cohort policies and CI configuration are unchanged.

goals.rationale: Aim near 70% for this exact starter recipe in each selected encounter, with an accepted 50-90% band. The existing pointwise 95% Wilson interval must lie wholly inside the band to pass; boundary overlap remains inconclusive. At least 100 valid trials are required. Any further confirmation uses a separately declared budget and fresh seeds, without extending completed experiments until they pass. These fixed pairs are not an area-wide spawn estimate or a requirement for every Essence.
goals.reviewReason: On 8 September 2026, after reviewing the coarse and fine pressure experiments, the user explicitly requested: Let's use a 50-90% win-rate band. This replaces the initial 65-75% band while retaining the earlier 70% aim, exact starter recipe and existing confidence-interval rule. This approves the revised scoped policy, not a production balance change, viable-baseline promotion, unrelated pacing goals or a hosted CI gate.
